content.title: Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 Sunday livestream: Watch Karol G, BigBang and FKA Twigs - Los Angeles Times
content.text: Updated April 17 for Coachella Weekend 2.Karol G headlines the final day of Coachella 2026. The festival’s first Latina headliner brought special guests like Mariah Angeliq, Becky G, Cigarettes After Sex and Wisin for Weekend 1. Who might she surprise fans with on Weekend 2? If you’re watching from home, there’s only one way to find out: the Coachella YouTube livestream.Before La Bichota closes out TropiCoachella round two, some of music’s biggest names are set to perform on the YouTube livestream: Wet Leg and Major Lazer on the main stage, Laufey and BigBang at the Outdoor Theatre, Iggy Pop and FKA Twigs at the Mojave and more.And check out Coachella’s livestream app on iOS and Android.Here are updated set times for Weekend 2’s Sunday livestream performances (times presented in PDT):Main Stage4 p.m. Tijuana Panthers; 4:45 p.m. Wet Leg; 6:10 p.m. Major Lazer; 7:50 p.m. Young Thug; 10:10 p.m. Karol GOutdoor Theatre4 p.m. Gigi Perez; 5:15 p.m. Clipse; 6:45 p.m. Foster the People; 8:45 p.m. Laufey; 10:30 p.m. BigBangSahara4 p.m. Girl Math (Vnssa x Nala); 5:05 p.m. Bunt.; 6:10 p.m. Duke Dumont; 7:25 p.m. Mochakk; 9:05 p.m. Subtronics; 10:50 p.m. KaskadeMojave4:25 p.m. Little Simz; 5:35 p.m. Suicidal Tendencies; 6:30 p.m. Samia; 7:10 p.m. Iggy Pop; 8:45 p.m. FKA TwigsGobi4:05 p.m. Cobrah; 5:15 p.m. Oklou; 6:30 p.m. Black Flag; 7:10 p.m. Flowerovlove; 7:45 p.m. Tomora; 9:05 p.m. the Rapture; 10 p.m. the ChatsYuma4 p.m. &friends; 4:15 p.m. Mestiza; 5:30 p.m. Carlita x Josh Baker; 7 p.m. Royksopp; 8:30 p.m. WhoMadeWho; 10 p.m. Green Velvet x AyyboQuasar4 p.m. Linska; 6 p.m. LP Giobbi; 8 p.m. Sara Landry’s Blood OathLivestream delays have happened in the past, so there’s a chance your favorite artist takes the stage later than expected.
